posts.description: Life Feels like something Nathan Barley would do Louise (in reference to streetpans) We went for lunch with the always excellent Simon and Louise on Sunday. The big box of craft we took with us to the pub just about counteracted the deliberate absence of an iPad. Not sure how a pub that claims to be family friendly can justify not serving chips though – that very nearly brought the whole operation

Life We had a two-day hackathon about image research, which inescapably equated to two days of telling Claude to do my bidding (so not vastly different from usual, although there were more snacks). I didn’t review any of the code, or engage with any other PR process, which made it much more enjoyable than the regular work situation. We went to Ηη ’s Year 2 assembly about the great fire of London.

Life Godot Darek didn’t come the next day. Or either of the days in the week he said he would. But on Sunday he finally made it. He claims to have fixed the leak, but we now have two new plumbing-related issues that he’s suggesting are coincidental. Seems unlikely! I think what’s going to happen is we’ll come to the end of the three month warranty period for the work and then get a proper plumber
